<!--
Four things that were wrong at once in plain LaTeX, three of them only in
journal mode.

  - A markdown table and a code chunk table in one document were both Table 1.
    markdowntable.lua stood down for FORMAT "latex", which was right when apa7
    was the only LaTeX format apaquarto had, so the markdown table never got an
    identifier and crossrefprefix.lua never counted it.

  - A reference to a float in an appendix printed the bare count, "Table 1",
    while the title above it read "Table A1".

  - In journal mode a longtable is set as a tabular, since a longtable refuses
    two columns. The four markers that say where the repeating head and the
    foot end were made to do nothing, so every row was set where it stood: a
    repeating head printed twice, a foot printed between the head and the body.

  - A raw LaTeX longtable with no \endlastfoot sent the collection that moves
    the foot reading to the end of the document.

The two raw tables stand in for flextable, which writes \endfirsthead and
\endhead always and \endlastfoot only for a table that has a footer. Raw LaTeX
says exactly what is being tested and needs no package to do it.
-->

# Method

See @tbl-md, @tbl-chunk, @tbl-apx and @fig-apx.

| Letters | Numbers |
|---------|---------|
| A       | 1       |

: A markdown table. {#tbl-md apa-note="A note on the markdown table."}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-chunk
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "A table written as a code chunk."
#| apa-note: "A note on the chunk table."
knitr::kable(data.frame(a = 1:2, b = 3:4))
```

A longtable with a head that repeats and a foot of its own.

```{=latex}
\begin{longtable}[]{@{}ll@{}}
\toprule\noalign{}
HEADMARKER & HEADTWO \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endfirsthead
\toprule\noalign{}
HEADMARKER & HEADTWO \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endhead
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{FOOTMARKER} \\
\endlastfoot
ROWONE & r1 \\
ROWTWO & r2 \\
\end{longtable}
```

A longtable with a head that repeats and no foot at all.

```{=latex}
\begin{longtable}[]{@{}ll@{}}
\toprule\noalign{}
NOFOOTHEAD & n2 \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endfirsthead
\toprule\noalign{}
NOFOOTHEAD & n2 \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endhead
NOFOOTROW & n4 \\
\end{longtable}
```
